caption: The drawing depicts a metal object consisting of a flat rectangular base with four short feet at each corner, supporting a series of four U-shaped arches of graduated sizes arranged in two pairs along the length of the base. An elongated handle with a rounded end and a hole near its tip is attached vertically through the middle of the base, able to pivot as indicated by the dashed lines showing its range of motion. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black pencil on an off-white or beige background. The main perspective drawing occupies the lower right quadrant, while above it, there are two smaller, technical line drawings: one is a frontal view with a small scale in inches below it, and the other is a side view showing the handle in both upright and inclined positions. The name "MILDRED FORD" is written in capital letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Toast Rack
